Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a tandem tag (moTAP) to isolate the LTβR signaling complex. While the paper discusses linear ubiquitination extensively and uses M1-AP for validation, the primary proteomic dataset (PXD034142) described in the methods and PRIDE metadata is the AP-MS of the complex, not a global ubiquitylome enrichment.
